answers.project_description: A web application that tracks and analyzes vehicle telemetry data from Assetto Corsa
answers.problem_statement: There's no easy way to compare telemetry data between different sessions or drivers
answers.key_goals: Python .exe application, read Shared Memory from Assetto Corsa, ACC, and AC Evo, display telemetry (RPM, gear, speed, pressures), export setups functionality
answers.design_principles: Real-time performance, Data clarity, Export flexibility
answers.tdd_strictness: Flexible - tests recommended for complex logic
